about: The broker's TMS lookup service, described rather than rebuilt (TC5 implementation 2). One HTTPS POST endpoint; the body is form-encoded (userid, password, request) and `request` is an XML service-request whose <data> is the tool's data template. Host, path and credentials come from the caller's environment: the client holds the credential.

tools.name: find_shipment_by_reference
tools.description: Find shipments already in the TMS whose reference number (PO, SO, BOL, load, confirmation or appointment number) exactly equals the value. Returns a list of shipment oids; an empty list means no shipment carries that reference. Read one with get_shipment.

reference.description: One reference number, exactly as written in the order

call.response: XML service-response; <data> holds the oids (base64 unless the server is set otherwise)

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description: Read one shipment already in the TMS: the whole record as XML (references, status, dates, shipper, consignee, temperature, weights, quantities, charges). About 10 KB.

call.response: XML service-response; <data> holds the shipment record

notes: Exact match only: a reference written with a prefix (P + 3-digit facility + PO) is not found as written.
Callers are allowed by IPv4 address; calls must come from an allowed address.
A reply can say SUCCESS while an import failed; read-only lookups are not affected.
